title: NVSS - Writing Cause-of-Death Statements
organization: CDC National Center for Health Statistics
usable_for: cause sequence vs family narrative distinction
do_not_use_for: medical certification instruction to lay readers
extraction_rules: Extract vocabulary, role boundaries, uncertainty structures, and review gates only; do not publish as legal, forensic, search, disaster-response, or family-notification advice.
Treat official records as one evidence stream, not the whole human truth of a death.
Do not include individual case details, images, lists, rare identifiers, or speculative identification attempts.
Cite source_id in every dependent record and recompute dependencies after record changes.
